meta.title: Award an unverified vendor
gaps: Locate the specific existing closed RFQ where Vendor C (not verified) bid lowest.
Verify from the UI that Vendor C is unverified before attempting the award.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Locate the specific existing closed RFQ where Vendor C (not verified) bid lowest.; Verify from the UI that Vendor C is unverified before attempting the award.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's buyer response screen without searching the events list.
Open Master QCS and require Vendor C to be present as the bidder to be awarded.

args.because: You cannot select bid for an unverified vendor.

steps.note: Attempt to allocate Vendor C and create the proposal; pass only if Procol refuses with the expected message.
